External matched score-change intervals include zero. This screen does not establish superiority in every promotion dimension.
4.03 uses the exact 4.01 NNUE checkpoint. Apex Policy25 testing and promotion are separate and not part of this release.
Long-clock Lazy vs Eager has not been established as a competitive Elo improvement in paired native-clock games.
